input: research.json and topic-map.json. No page count or outline was given.
method: Start from the topic map's natural boundaries. Each boundary is a candidate page.
Split a candidate when its concepts need more than one Diataxis job (one page, one job).
Merge small neighbors that share one job and would not stand alone.
Order pages so every concept's dependsOn is taught on the same page or an earlier one. The entry reader has only typed casual prompts.
Anything the subject implies but the series should not do goes in excluded, with a reason.

verdict.why: The subject splits into one-shot craft, cross-generation continuity, chaining mechanics, and planning grammar, with a dependency chain from shot sizes through the axis to coverage. One page cannot hold all four jobs.
verdict.provisional: runVersion 1 produces only the first page's sheet, per the run's assignment. Pages 2-4 are scoped so dependencies are checkable, but their sheets wait for trunk review.

pages.title: Make one honest 8-10 second shot
pages.outcome: Can produce one coherent 8-10 second clip from their own story idea by giving it one beat, a deliberate start frame, and a static or motivated camera, and can say why the result holds together.

pages.title: Keep the character, the style, and the light
pages.outcome: Can hold one character, one aesthetic, and one lighting recipe stable across three generations using reference images and verbatim prompt lines, with an honest account of what a seed does and does not do.

pages.title: Chain two shots without a seam
pages.outcome: Can chain two clips through a shared frame, recognize and avoid the lens-switch failure, and place the seam on motion.

pages.title: Plan coverage: the axis, the wide first, the shot list
pages.outcome: Can plan a short sequence as a written shot list that keeps the axis, establishes space before coverage, and assigns each shot its framing, beat, camera, duration, and references.

excluded.why: Capabilities change monthly; the series teaches the craft and links the dated docs instead of teaching one tool's buttons.

excluded.what: Editing software, color grading, and sound design
excluded.why: Post-production is its own subject; the series ends at planned, chainable clips.

excluded.what: Long-form generation beyond the clip scale
excluded.why: The craft problem is the 8-10 second clip and its chaining; feature-length workflows inherit this rather than replace it.
The reader's camera is a model; lenses, rigs, and lights do not transfer.
